Guides: Robot Vacuums · Power Stations · Best Sellers · Price Check · Recall Check

Is the one you own recalled? Every US recall since January 2025 for the kinds of things we cover (heating and sleep, power banks and batteries, car, kitchen, cleaning and bathroom). 222 recalls, newest first, from the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission.

How to check: type the brand or the model number from the label (often on the plug, the controller or under the base). If it matches, stop using it and follow the remedy on the CPSC notice: most recalls offer a refund or a free repair. Then report any incident at SaferProducts.gov.

Jump to: Heating and sleep (74) · Power banks and batteries (66) · Car (15) · Kitchen (33) · Cleaning (22) · Bathroom (12)

About this page

  • Source: the CPSC's recall database (SaferProducts.gov API), the official US record. We sort recalls into our categories by their titles and leave out toys and children's products, which the CPSC lists at cpsc.gov/Recalls.
  • Updated: October 29, 2026. We refresh it every week; a recall can be announced any day, so the CPSC notice is the final word.
  • "Sold at" names the stores the CPSC lists; we leave out the prices. Where a recall names a brand we cover, the card links our guide.
  • No affiliate links on this page. How we rank · Disclosure
